reader.requirement: At --std 85 each INITIATE sets the report's LINE-COUNTER to zero and every page advance the RWCS executes resets it to zero before the page heading is processed; only the RWCS changes it (a program's MOVE into it is refused).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup restores LINE-COUNTER from the NEXT GROUP save at TERMINATE (not INITIATE or page advance; inactive at 85)

reader.edition-search: Initiate sets LineCounter = 0 and PageFeed sets LineCounter = 0 unconditionally; neither reads Edition or DialectBehaviors (grep of Edition in ReportWriter.cs). The receiving-operand refusal COBOL2197 is edition-independent.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf36_06 covers INITIATE of two reports, a re-INITIATE and the overflow advance after NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE; the LINE ON NEXT PAGE and absolute-LINE advances and EXTEND mode are probe-only

probes.printed: INITIATE -> LC 00; each of the three advances -> 'PH: ... LC 00' in USE BEFORE REPORTING of the page heading; after TERMINATE LC 07, then INITIATE -> LC 00
probes.expected: zero after INITIATE and at each page advance

probes.printed: error COBOL2197: LINE-COUNTER shall not be referenced as a receiving operand
probes.expected: refused: §1985:XIII.3.5.6 GR2 only the RWCS can change it

probes.printed: OPEN EXTEND: the same LC trace

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.6 GR4  (3.5.6 LINE-COUNTER Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: Witness g85_bf36_06 MATCHes at 85. COBOL2197 cites §2023:8.4.3.15.3 SR3 at 85 rather than the 1985 rule, a wording issue only.

refuter.evidence: ini2.cob (runs/ini2-002): each of two reports INITIATEd in one statement shows LINE-COUNTER 00 (L1 00 L2 00), both first and after TERMINATE and re-INITIATE in reverse order, whatever value the RWCS had left (02/04). sup.cob: the page advance after the suppressed group shows 'PH: PC 00000002 LC 00'. The suppressed group itself left LC at 05 (§1985:XIII.3.5.6 GR5 cite.py OK, 'whose printing is suppressed by means of the SUPPRESS statement'), so a reset happens only on a real advance. cfnp.cob: no advance, no reset (LC 08 into the PF). Initiate and PageFeed set LineCounter = 0 with no edition read. The TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup arm runs at TERMINATE, not at INITIATE or at a page advance, and Initiate clears _nextGroupSave unconditionally, so nothing saved survives into a new INITIATE. cite.py: OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.6 GR4  (3.5.6 LINE-COUNTER Rules)  the text is in GR4.
